description: Pycha, the spirit of pride, a tall haughty figure looking down its nose, one wide chunky shape filling the whole picture, a pale cold mask-like face with half-closed disdainful eyes, a tall golden crown, a long purple and gold cloak spread wide, chin raised, one hand raised in contempt, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the figure alone, no throne, no ground, no background, the whole figure inside the picture, the crown too
